here is what they said, what does this mean? Hello Antonio,



Thank you for submitting your support request regarding the Production keyset disabled.



To activate your production keyset, please address the eBay Marketplace Account Deletion/Closure Notifications requirement by either:



1. Subscribing to the Notifications: If your application stores eBay user data, you must integrate the notifications workflow. This ensures you are notified when an eBay user requests the deletion of their personal data.



2. Opting Out: If your application does not persist eBay user data, you may opt out of this requirement.



For more detailed information, please visit the following link which provides further guidance on each step of the process: https://developer.ebay.com/marketplace-account-deletion.



If you have any further questions or need additional assistance, please feel free to reach out.
